plugin.name: YouTubeMusic
plugin.title: YouTube Music
plugin.desc: Browse, search, and stream YouTube Music to your Squeezebox players.
plugin.changes: Fixes the server running out of memory (and crashing) on small machines when two tracks start at the same moment: only one stream link is decoded at a time. Sections in New Releases now have their real names. New icon. "Go to artist" / "Go to album" in every track's menu. Tracks no longer stop early when a download is cut off. Podcasts menu hidden. Based on upstream 1.5.1, plus download priority within 2 downloads.
plugin.creator: schmij97, NikolajChristensen
